item_description:
Script: dbu can. According to [8H6M69W4]: blockprint (shing dpar), which is doubtful in view of the annotation "zhus te dag go" at the end, unless the blockprint reproduces this from a manuscript.
Note in the left margin on the cover page: blo' dpal chen (possibly the name of the owner).
The signature number (22 according to [8H6M69W4], No. 15403) is unclear on the reproduction.
Annotations in dbu med (glosses) and dbu can (corrections).
